originality.rationale: Six actual semantic queries found nearby but not covering claims; checked accessible historical claims and relevant primary full-text sections. Existing metacyclic theory gives only commuting probability (zero target, genus one) and general lower bounds, while Levy gives a general character identity plus exponent-p explicit families. The new simultaneous all-target all-genus equivalence and equal-order, unbounded-class counterexamples are not stated or implied by the inspected concrete results; standard determinant/character identities are background and not claimed as novel. Residual risk remains from an unlocated stronger specialization.
residual_risks: A broader unidentified character-table or isoclinism-type theorem might imply the same normalized surface-word law after specialized computation.
Not every potentially relevant older metacyclic word-map paper was accessible or exhaustively searched; publication priority is not independently established.

value.rationale: The complete all-target all-genus word law is a motivated natural invariant, and its sharp universal mixing and same-order groups with arbitrarily different nilpotency classes give a structural non-detectability theorem not implied by the previously published commuting probability alone. The exact identification is useful as a benchmark for surface-word statistical invariants of finite p-groups.
